termsBody: yuoyuo provides AI character conversations and character creation for adults aged 18 or older. The service is unavailable in mainland China. You must provide accurate account information and protect your login credentials. AI replies are fictional and may be inaccurate; they are not medical, legal or financial advice. You retain rights to your original creations and grant us permission to store, display and process them to provide the visibility and features you choose. Do not upload material you do not have permission to use. We may restrict content or accounts that violate these rules. The international preview has usage limits and does not currently accept payments. Contact support for service complaints or account assistance. Mandatory consumer rights under applicable law are not excluded.
privacyBody: We process your email, profile, age information, account preferences, character content, conversations and technical logs to operate and secure the service. Conversation context may be sent to configured AI providers to generate replies; do not share secrets or other people's sensitive data in chat. Hosting, email and AI processing may take place in countries other than yours. Private characters and chats are not published in the public catalogue. You can export account data and request deletion in Account; deletion includes a recovery period, and limited security, legal or backup records may be retained where necessary. Contact privacy@yuoyuo.app to ask about access, correction, deletion, processors or retention. We do not currently run advertising in this preview.
contentPolicyBody: Create and share only content you have the right to use. Sexual content involving minors, sexual violence, non-consensual intimate imagery, impersonation for deception, exploitation, threats, doxxing and instructions for serious harm are prohibited. Do not portray a real person as endorsing or participating in a fictional relationship without permission. Public character submissions are reviewed and may be rejected or removed. Use the reporting contact to flag harmful or infringing material. Age confirmation does not make otherwise prohibited content acceptable.
refundsBody: New purchases and paid subscriptions are not available in the international preview. We do not collect payment card details or redirect users to Afdian. Existing balances and membership records may be preserved during migration. Contact support for questions about an existing purchase; the applicable original purchase terms and mandatory consumer rights still apply. Pricing, renewal, cancellation and refund terms will be published before any new paid offering opens.
